description: Investigations Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. About the Data The dataset includes publicly available NHTSA investigation information related to the identification and correction of safety-related defects in motor vehicles and vehicle equipment. For more information on NHTSA investigations, including safety defect investigations, please visit. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 10 columns, among them Component , Primary Manufacturer, Subject, Date Opened, NHTSA Link, Latest Recall. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. Attribution given: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
